summary: Describes how the IESG handles documents submitted for RFC publication from the Independent Submission and IRTF streams. It updates procedures from RFC 2026 and RFC 3710. It is a Best Current Practice.

eli5.summary: Some documents arrive at the RFC editor from outside the main working groups. This explains how the IESG checks them to make sure they do not conflict with the main work.

questions: how does the iesg review independent submissions
what is the iesg conflict review
